info.title: SKU.io — Build Bills of Materials from a Recipe Sheet
info.description: Create bills of materials (BOMs, recipes) for manufactured products from the user's recipe sheet, after approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Bills of materials" step, when onboarding a manufacturer, or when a manufactured product has no recipe. Never edits or deletes an existing BOM.

get.summary: List or search products. With filter[type]=manufactured it returns the population the Launch Roadmap checks (skip rows with a non-null archived_at). With filter[search] it finds an ingredient the sheet names instead of giving its SKU. BOM lines accept only products that carry stock (standard, kit, blemished, manufactured).

parameters.name: filter[type]
parameters.description: Comma-separated product types, e.g. manufactured, or standard,manufactured.

schema.description: Comma-separated product types, e.g. manufactured, or standard,manufactured.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Free-text search across SKU, name, barcode, MPN and brand.

schema.description: Free-text search across SKU, name, barcode, MPN and brand.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size (default 10). Iterate page until last_page.

schema.description: Page size (default 10). Iterate page until last_page.

get.summary: List BOMs with product_id, status, version_number, component_lines_count and archived_at. Archived BOMs are excluded unless filter[archived]=all.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Matches BOM id, BOM name, or the product's name or SKU.

schema.description: Matches BOM id, BOM name, or the product's name or SKU.

post.summary: Create one BOM with its component lines. product_id, name and effective_from are required; the primary output line (product_id x 1) is added for you when output_lines is omitted. Returns the BOM with its id and lines.

product_id.description: The manufactured product this recipe makes.

status.description: BomStatus: draft, active or archived. Send draft; a person activates it after review. Over the MCP server leave it out (sending it is refused; MCP BOMs are always drafts).

version_notes.description: Free text — record the source sheet and row here.

expected_yield_percent.description: 0–100. Only when the sheet states a yield.

default_consumption_method.description: forward_flush or backflush. Omit unless the user says how they issue materials.

output_lines.description: Omit for a single finished product. Each { product_id, role (primary, coproduct, byproduct, scrap), quantity, uom_id }. Use it when one batch yields more than one unit (product_id, role primary, quantity 12) so component quantities are per batch.

component_lines.description: The recipe. Each { product_id (required), quantity (required, >= 0), uom_id (optional — defaults to the product's stock unit; must be enabled on the product), expected_scrap_percent (0–100), consumption_method, is_optional, notes, sort_order }. The roadmap counts a BOM only when it has at least one component line.

get.summary: Resolve an ingredient or part SKU from the recipe sheet to its product id and type.
The account's units of measure (id, name, code, type). Use to map the sheet's units ("kg", "ea", "ml") to uom ids.

parameters.name: uom_type
parameters.description: Optional filter by unit type, e.g. weight.

schema.description: Optional filter by unit type, e.g. weight.

get.summary: The units of measure enabled for one product (its stock unit plus alternates). A BOM line's uom_id must be one of these.
Fetch one BOM with its component and output lines, to verify after creating it.
